title: Deleting a Part Library entry that a part uses is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-INUSE-01) has an inventory part behind it at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the edit icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Click Delete.
  6. Confirm the deletion when the confirmation asks.
  7. Wait 5 seconds.
  8. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  9. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  10. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  11. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The delete is refused. A red error toast reads "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted." with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."
  • Step 7: The toast has closed on its own after about 3 seconds.
  • Step 9: {Part-A} is still listed in the Part Library.
  • Step 11: The inventory part {Part-A} is still listed and unchanged.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S12-R11, S12-R13, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy.
